limits: This historical run predates the command-policy negative-test and lifecycle-script-denial controls added later in PR #13.
The run evaluated a GitHub pull-request merge ref, not a future final main commit.
The Docker image built successfully, but the base-image digest remains unpinned.
The run does not establish independent reproduction or equal verification depth.

command_policy_contract.evidence_rule: The current pass or failure belongs in the workflow or evidence record for the exact assessed commit; this declaration does not self-certify it.

allowed_claims: Riverbraid-Evaluation-Kit is the current public entry and evaluation surface for the declared Riverbraid governance floor.

The repository contains a pinned 30-repository registry, expected results, a bounded command-dispatch policy, an explicit unsupported-command negative test, lifecycle-script-denied npm installation, container and workflow scaffolding, and public reproduction instructions.
A specific execution may claim only that the configured commands and policy tests produced the recorded results under the observed source, environment, and evaluator version.
Registry command depth varies and must remain visible when interpreting any aggregate result.

current_limitations.claim_effect: Lifecycle scripts are denied, but npm dependency acquisition still uses the network and therefore does not support an offline, hermetic, or fully supply-chain-isolated claim.
A successful Docker build does not support an immutable base-image or fully hermetic reproduction claim while the digest remains unpinned.
The pinned registry is a profile snapshot and must not be described as automatically fresh relative to default branches.
A registry pass does not establish equal behavioral verification depth across all 30 entries.

refused_claims: equal verification depth across all registry entries
review_triggers: new workflow run against a changed merge or main subject
execution evidence that closes or changes a listed limitation
nonclaims: This declaration is not itself execution evidence.
A successful repository-owned workflow does not establish independent reproduction.
The presence of the negative test and lifecycle-script denial does not prove they passed for an exact commit; consult the corresponding workflow record.
This declaration does not upgrade a presence check into a behavioral verifier.
This declaration does not close issues 8, 9, 10, or 11.
